# Fukuii

Fukuii is a multi-EVM execution client in Scala 3, maintained by Chippr Robotics LLC.
Native Proof-of-Work for Ethereum Classic (chain 61) and Mordor (chain 63),
plus Engine API V1–V4 for Ethereum (chain 1), Sepolia (chain 11155111), and Holesky.
One binary, any network. The primary ETC client for the Olympia era.

> ⚠️ ALPHA SOFTWARE — DO NOT USE IN PRODUCTION

## Key Capabilities

- Sync: SNAP, fast, and full sync modes
- Engine API V1–V4 (Prague/Electra, validated on Sepolia with Lighthouse)
- SLSA Level 3 provenance — verified, reproducible builds with Cosign keyless signing
- CycloneDX SBOM on all release artifacts
- MCP server — machine-readable JSON-RPC interface for agentic operations
- Pluggable consensus: PoW (ETC/Ethash), PoS via Engine API (Ethereum), PoA (custom chains)
- 3,621 tests; 14 Hive compliance simulator suites wired into CI
- JVM/Scala 3 diversity — independent dependency tree from Go/Rust dominant clients
- Forked from Mantis (IOHK) — battle-tested cryptographic foundation

## Supported Networks

- Ethereum Classic (chain 61) — PoW/Ethash, full SNAP sync, Olympia fork
- Mordor (chain 63) — ETC PoW testnet
- Ethereum Mainnet (chain 1) — PoS via Engine API
- Sepolia (chain 11155111) — PoS testnet
- Holesky — PoS testnet
- Private/consortium chains — custom genesis, no source modification required
- EVM-compatible L2s — chains configured via custom genesis and derivation rules

## Requirements

- Runtime: JDK 25 LTS
- Language: Scala 3.3.7 LTS
- Disk: 500 GB+ (SNAP sync — home node)
- RAM: 8 GB minimum

## Quick Start

    docker pull ghcr.io/chippr-robotics/fukuii:latest

    # Ethereum Classic mainnet
    docker run -p 8553:8553 -p 30305:30305 ghcr.io/chippr-robotics/fukuii:latest \
      --network classic

    # Sepolia (requires consensus layer: Lighthouse, Prysm, etc.)
    docker run -p 8553:8553 -p 30305:30305 ghcr.io/chippr-robotics/fukuii:latest \
      --network sepolia

## Architecture Roadmap (Orbita)

1. Phase 1 — fukuii-env extraction: per-chain config struct, one binary / multiple envs
2. Phase 2 — Multi-instance runtime: single process manages multiple (state_db, env, engine_api) tuples
3. Phase 3 — Checkpoint consensus module: PoA sidechain checkpointing to parent chain (Orbita PoA)
4. Phase 4 — OP-style derivation module: L2 block derivation from L1 batches/blobs
